title: Chapter 1 — AI practice mock 4
instructions: Short original AI-authored practice, inspired by the teacher-topic questions; not an official or full-length mock. Self-mark using the guidance.

questions.text: A mono recording is sampled 8000 times per second at 8 bits per sample for 2 seconds. Calculate its size in bits, ignoring metadata.

answer.text: The number of audio samples taken per second.

questions.text: Explain the effect of increasing sample resolution.

answer.text: More bits per sample allow more amplitude levels and increase file size.

questions.explanation: Do not confuse resolution with sample rate.
